usage.outputShape: body.data[] is an array of {symbol, prices[]}; each price is {currency, value, lastUpdatedAt}. USD price = body.data[0].prices[0].value (string).
quirks: URL requires a ?symbols= query param even though inputSchema is null — a bare GET would return no useful data; pass one or more tickers comma-separated (e.g. ?symbols=ETH or ?symbols=ETH,BTC,USDC)
Prices come back as STRINGS, not numbers (value:"1684.84")
Each token's prices is an array keyed by currency (currently just usd)
Pay confirmed:false in result but on-chain payment went through and 200 returned with live data — settlement is fine
usage.guide: Call GET https://x402.alchemy.com/prices/v1/tokens/by-symbol with a ?symbols= query string listing one or more ticker symbols (comma-separated for multiple, e.g. ?symbols=ETH,BTC). Pay via x402 USDC on Base ($0.001/call). Read prices from body.data[]: match by .symbol, then take .prices[0].value (a USD price string) and .prices[0].lastUpdatedAt for freshness. No auth or API key needed; payment is the only gate.
